items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: She played piano and sang. I played with her for a little -- short while.

ctx.x: She played piano and sang. I played with her for a little -- short while. They used to call her the Chi-Chi girl (Laughter.) -- where she used to sing her favorite number was 'I Can't Give You Anything But Love, Chi-Chi,' with a high voice? You may have heard. I played with her for, oh, about a year or so.
